_comment: Milestone A step 9 (OPTIMIZE resolver pass -- the FULL production config: checkSiblingIntersections=1/checkAncestorIntersections=1/optimize=1). Structures where the VENDORED RNApuzzler oracle (src/vienna_layout, plot_coords_puzzler_opts / plot_coords_puzzler_full's oracle counterpart) does not terminate under this configuration. EMPTY: same finding as hard_set_sibling_ancestor_oracle_hangs.json (also empty) -- with checkAncestorIntersections=1 also on, the ancestor pass runs before the sibling pass at every tree level on every restart and can make progress even when the sibling pass alone cannot, which already breaks every one of the 450 hard_set structures' potential infinite loops. Turning optimize on as well adds NO new hang risk: optimizeTree/optimizeNode/optimizeTreeRecursive (optimize.inc) are all internally bounded (shrinkLoopRadiusLinearSearch: 10 steps; searchBestConfig: 10 steps; optimizeNode's own while loop: runNrMax = 100*configSize; optimizeTreeRecursive's do-while only continues while SOME node's radius strictly decreased, and radius is bounded below by cfg.minRadius, so it cannot decrease forever) -- optimize can only make an already-terminating resolve pass slower, never non-terminating. Verified directly (not via a timeout probe, since none was needed): ran the vendored oracle's plot_coords_puzzler_opts(structure, False, 0, 1.0) over the full 436 turtle-usable structures of hard_set.json in-process; completed cleanly in ~14s with zero hangs. This file exists (rather than being omitted) for the same reason hard_set_sibling_ancestor_oracle_hangs.json does -- a single, consistent exclusion-list mechanism across every resolver-combination test suite, and an obvious place to record a future hang if a corpus change ever reintroduces one.
